meta.name: astropy
meta.description: Core Python library for astronomy and astrophysics workflows that need Astropy APIs, including units/quantities, coordinates, FITS I/O, tables, time systems, WCS, and cosmology. Use when implementing or debugging astronomical data analysis code with Astropy.

copy.tagline: 处理天文数据与物理量计算
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用Python做天文数据处理或模拟。
copy.tagline_en: Process astronomical data and physical quantities
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with astronomical data or simulations in Python.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以调用 Astropy 库进行天文计算：转换天体坐标、处理物理单位、读写 FITS 文件、操作天体表格、计算宇宙学距离、处理时间等。
howto.when: 当用户寻求帮助处理天文数据或代码，涉及坐标、单位、FITS 文件、表格、时间或宇宙学计算时触发。

say.text: 把RA=10.5度，Dec=41.2度的ICRS坐标转成银道坐标。
say.note: Claude会使用astropy进行坐标转换并返回结果。

say.text: 帮我读一个叫image.fits的文件，显示图像尺寸和头信息。
计算红移z=1.5的光度距离，用Planck18宇宙学模型。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the Astropy library for astronomical computations: coordinate transformations, unit conversions, FITS file I/O, table operations, cosmological calculations, time handling, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users seek help with astronomical data analysis or code involving coordinates, units, FITS files, tables, time, or cosmology.

say_en.text: Convert ICRS coordinates RA=10.5 deg, Dec=41.2 deg to galactic.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.coordinates to perform the transformation.

say_en.text: Read a FITS file called image.fits and show its dimensions and header info.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.io.fits to open and parse the file.

say_en.text: Calculate luminosity distance at z=1.5 using Planck18 cosmology.
say_en.note: Claude uses astropy.cosmology to compute the distance.
